sloka: चिरायमाणे दूते तु राजा क्रोधसमन्वितः ।अर्दयामास तद्रक्षः शरवृष्ट्या समन्ततः ।। ७.६७.१९ ॥
transliteration: cirāyamāṇe dūte tu rājā krodhasamanvitaḥ ।ardayāmāsa tadrakṣaḥ śaravṛṣṭyā samantataḥ ।। 7.67.19 ॥

translations.english: When the messenger delayed, the king, filled with anger, attacked that demon Lavaṇa from all sides with a shower of arrows.
